title: XDC masternode realised yield
description: What masternodes actually earned over 1, 7 and 30 days, from measured epoch rewards.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this document.

version.description: Major version of this document's format. Fields are only added within a version.

generated_at.description: When this data was produced. ISO 8601, UTC.

update_interval_seconds.description: How often this document is regenerated.

stale_after_seconds.description: If generated_at is older than this, treat the data as stale (the feed may have stopped).

license.description: SPDX licence identifier for the data.

note.description: Optional remark about this copy of the data.

live_url.description: For hourly copies: the live URL this was copied from.

as_of_day.description: Last UTC day with recorded epochs.

price.description: Null unless the publisher has switched prices on (they are off by default): then the XDC price when the epoch was recorded, and null for epochs filled in later.

at.description: When the price was read. ISO 8601, UTC.

min_candidate_stake_xdc.description: Minimum candidate stake from the validator contract.

epochs_with_typical.description: Epochs with a typical node reward.

days_covered.description: Days of data behind the figures: epochs recorded x the average epoch length.

complete.description: True if at least 90 % of the window's epochs are recorded.

typical_node_reward_per_epoch_xdc.description: Average typical node reward per epoch (owner share).

typical_node_xdc_per_day.description: Typical node reward per epoch x epochs per day (so epochs missing from the record do not lower it).

apr_pct_on_min_stake.description: Per year / minimum candidate stake, in percent (simple, no compounding).
